# MrBigStage: code map

<!-- generated by APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py · 2026-11-14 · code f1ddb61f265d · regenerate after every change -->

**Read this first, then open only the files it points to.** Line numbers are where definitions start; read
around them with an offset instead of whole files.

**What it is:** Step onto a big stage in VR, give your talk to a 3D audience and get coached on your voice: pace, pauses, fillers, pitch, volume and eye contact.
**Live:** https://mrbigstage.anvil.app · **Repo:** github.com/arkulinskis/mrbigstage · **Layout:** native Anvil Forms · **Deploy:** master
**Guide** (workflow, design rules, product knowledge): `mrbigstage/.claude/skills/mrbigstage/SKILL.md`

## How to change it

- **New page**: copy a similar `client_code/Pages/<Name>/` (form_template.html + __init__.py), register it in
  `client_code/router.py` (`PAGES`, `_form()`, and `NAV` for the menu). Address = `#name/arg`.
- **New list**: a RepeatingPanel in the page template + `client_code/Items/<Name>/`. **Dialog**: `client_code/Dialogs/<Name>/` opened with `alert(...)`.
- **New server function**: `@anvil.server.callable` in the matching `server_code` module (see *Server*), called with `state.call("name", ...)`.
- **New table/column**: `anvil.yaml` → `db_schema` (the user accepts Anvil's Schema Mismatch alert); update the server-test mock.
- **Drawing/media/canvas**: a JavaScript engine in `theme/assets/` wrapped by a Python module or a `Components/` form.
- **Styles**: `theme/assets/app.css` (colour tokens at the top; rules in APP_MAKER/design/README.md).
- **Check**: `python tools/check.py` → ALL CHECKS PASSED; UI: `python -I tools/ui_test.py` (Docker Desktop running).
- **Deploy**: commit as arkulinskis (+ Co-Authored-By) and `git push` (master unless apps.json says branch-first).
- **Footer** must keep: Submit feedback (Prepsto), Privacy & Terms, Contact developer (arkvital.com), Parent company (addanapp.com).
- **After any change**: `python -I C:/Users/arkvi/Documents/CLAUDE/APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py mrbigstage` refreshes this map.

## Notes

<!-- NOTES: hand-written, kept when the map is regenerated -->
- **Forms version (branch `forms`, 2026-11-08).** Pages, menus, dialogs and lists are Forms; the engines stay JavaScript in
  theme/assets: `mb-stage.js` (the whole #stage page: setup, mic check, green room, talk, VR, Q&A, results; `MB.mountStage(view, {args, me})`
  -> `{ready, destroy}`, mounted by Pages/Stage on show, destroyed on hide), `mb-venue.js` (three.js rooms + crowd sounds),
  `mb.js` (MB.content, MB.Voice analyser, MB.Transcript, MB.Tapes in IndexedDB, MB.ring/spark/bars/timeline SVG),
  `mb-charts.js` (hero art, trend/nerves/calendar charts, MB.mountTape = the report's recording player), `ark-music.js`.
- **Engine -> server bridge:** `client_code/mb.py install_bridge()` sets `window.MB_PY = {call, toast, after, show}`; mb.js
  rebuilds `UI.api / UI.apiQuiet / UI.toast / UI.go / UI.after` on top of it, so the engines keep their old code.
  A Python function called from JS returns a Promise when it makes a server call.
- **Private addresses:** `router.needs_account` sends guests to sign in for `#stage/<talk id>` and `#report/<id>`;
  `#stage/sample|free|drill:<key>` and `#report/guest` (sessionStorage `mb.guestReport`, written by the stage) are open.
- **Charts** go into `Components/Chart` (`content` = markup from an MB.* function); the score ring is `Components/Ring`.
  Report skill bars are real Items (Items/PartBar, click to explain); Progress/Admin skill bars use MB.bars.
- **CSS:** app.css = template core with the app's tokens + "MrBigStage skin" + old page CSS (class names kept) + role layer +
  "component version" block at the end. Old wrapper class `.ic` on drill icons was renamed `.dr-ic` (clashes with the icon kit).
- Tests: `tools/ui/smoke.js` (`python -I tools/ui_test.py --only smoke.js`) opens every address as guest, member, admin.
  VR can't be tested headless; music_sync.py still points at the old `_arkmusic.html` (needs `mrbigstage-forms/theme/assets/ark-music.js`, "file").
<!-- /NOTES -->

## Tools

- `tools/assets.py`: Refresh the theme assets' cache-busting hashes in anvil.yaml (and icons.css).
- `tools/build_icons.py`: Write theme/assets/icons.css from the icon table in theme/assets/lh-kit.js (UI.ICONS).
- `tools/check.py`: Everything that must pass before pushing. Ends with ALL CHECKS PASSED.
- `tools/make_icons.py`: Make the PNG app icons from theme/assets/icon.svg (headless Chrome draws them).
- `tools/session_test.py`: Expired-session test: the app must reload quietly (same page, still signed in, typed text kept) ins…
- `tools/ui_test.py`: Run the app for real in the open-source Anvil App Server (Docker) and drive it with headless Chrome.
